title: Structure of $t$-Intersecting Families of Vector Spaces
summary: We study $t$-intersecting and $t$-cross-intersecting families of $k$-dimensional subspaces in finite vector spaces of dimension $n$. We show that all large $t$-intersecting families admit a governing low-dimensional structure for $n \ge 2k+1$. This result, together with its cross-intersecting variant, allows us to prove analogues of several classical extremal set-theoretic results. In particular, we determine the intersecting families with the largest diversity, and we establish a Frankl-type degree-diversity result that generalizes the Hilton-Milner theorem.
